## Update log

**Jun 9th, 9:10 a.m.** — Opened onboarding ticket for six new Marrow Agrisupply stores. Received the receiving-team roster and store address sheet. Working labels are North Creek, Elm Junction, Prairie Bend, Mill Crossing, West Ridge, and South Fork; these match the supplied sheet.

**Jun 9th, 10:35 a.m.** — Created the store setup checklist. North Creek and Elm Junction need separate appointment windows for bagged feed and palletized garden stock. Prairie Bend’s door 2 is marked unavailable during the morning forklift inspection. Added that restriction before importing the schedue.

**Jun 9th, 1:20 p.m.** — Test appointments saved successfully at four stores. West Ridge has a duplicate receiving contact; South Fork’s notification email bounced. Requested corrected details and held those two invites.

**Jun 9th, 3:45 p.m.** — Sent screenshots of the appointment view and a short receiving checklist. Remaining follow-up: contact corrections, invite resend, and final config review before tomorrow’s shift. Recieved acknowledgement from the store coordinator.
